shims.summary: Agent 0.23.3 moved sessions, the runtime store's refusal and admissions, and hosted rooms behind persistence_assembly; tests seed older Agents through SessionDB, hermes_state_runtime and room store paths.
agent.conversation_compression.compaction_status_kind is new in 0.23.2; older Agents rely on the wording markers.
The Agent writers' drop_other_access policy is new in 0.23.2; the sidecar applies it to config.yaml itself.
hermes_cli.config_secret_refs is new in 0.23.2; older Agents keep an entered model credential inline in config.yaml.
The cron prompt and job-argument checks moved to cron.prompt_scan and cron.job_args in 0.23.2; older Agents keep them in tools.cronjob_*.
A per-task cron wrap_response is new in 0.23.2; older Agents read only the global cron.wrap_response, so the sidecar reports no capability and refuses an explicit value.
BasicAuthProvider(credential_id=) is new in 0.23.2; older Agents sign dashboard sessions with the secret alone.
Per-home plugin registration ownership is new in 0.23.2; older Agents attribute a provider by its module path.
